sources.title: deepseek-v4-pro-0813 Model by Deepseek-ai | NVIDIA NIM
sources.snippet: DeepSeek-V4-Pro-0813 is DeepSeek-AI's official DeepSeek-V4-Pro release. It supersedes the preview model, adds a DSpark speculative-decoding module, and is designed for text generation, reasoning, coding, and agentic tool-use workflows.

sources.title: DeepSeek-V4-Pro-0813 — Benchmarks, Specs & Release Date
sources.snippet: DeepSeek-V4-Pro-0813 Released Aug 13 2026 DeepSeek-V4-Pro-0813 is an AI model released by DeepSeek on Thursday, Aug 13 2026, 13 days after DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731. Benchmark results (shown below) cover BullshitBench v2, Terminal-Bench 2.1, Toolathlon-Verified, CyberGym, Humanity's Last Exam, and AutomationBench.
